title: Studio Core, NPC/Creature Recipe/Constraint Engine & Resolution Authority
objective: Establish the MNCS studio core over shared PCA/PPIA/Packet-06 substrate with stable candidate identity, recipe/context projection, deterministic receipts where claimed, locks/rerolls/selective regeneration and progressive-resolution invariants without taking canonical NPC/Creature or owner-domain authority.

satisfied_by: PPIA-02 Creature & NPC Experience status completed_verified and Character/NPC/Creature owner contracts available

scope.purpose: Implement stable candidate identity, recipe/context projection, deterministic receipts where claimed, locks/rerolls/selective regeneration and progressive-resolution invariants over shared PCA/PPIA/Packet-06 substrate.
scope.completion_gate: A bounded MNCS studio core can create and selectively resolve NPC/creature candidates through governed recipes/constraints while preserving stable identity, locks, accepted fields, unresolved facts and canonical owner-domain boundaries.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 is the activation authority and explicitly permits MNCS start after MCCS-01 plus MIB-09, DPL completed_verified and NPC/Creature owner contracts.
MIB-09 is completed_verified; DPL is completed_verified; PPIA-02 Creature & NPC Experience is completed_verified and supplies the current Creature/NPC experience contract.
PPIA-02 and Character/NPC/Creature owners retain Definition, placement, live-instance, conversion and entity authority.
PCA recipe/generation infrastructure remains generic substrate; MNCS-01 owns only NPC/creature-specific recipes, constraints, locks, selective regeneration and interpretation.
MCCS retains appearance/presentation authoring; MNCS may later request/bind presentation outputs without making appearance canonical entity truth.
MCCS-21 remains an MNCS golden-proof dependency but is not a start requirement for MNCS-01 under the live DAG.

MNCS-01 is governed-started on branch work/mncs-01-studio-core-resolution-authority from application main 2260225b68bba71069a9f32e72b525617be585a9; implementation authority is limited to this bounded tranche.
The independent ui-implementation lane is preserved unchanged.
next_action: Establish causal RED for stable candidate identity, recipe/constraint resolution, locks/rerolls/selective regeneration and progressive-resolution invariants, then implement only bounded MNCS-01 behavior through validation, serialized publication and closeout.
